name: Landsea Green Life Service Company Limited
summary: Landsea Green Life Service Company Limited has operated since 2005 from Nanjing, offering property management and supporting services to developers, owners and residents across China. Core work includes security, cleaning, landscaping, parking and repairs, with sales support and pre-delivery advice for non-owners. It also provides home cleaning and repair, advertising and public space rental, second-hand property transactions, brokerage and engineering consulting.
